summary.text: Dan Goughnour is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 35 who has served since April 7, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Goughnour is a former police detective who lives in McKeesport.

paragraphs.text: Dan Goughnour lives in McKeesport, Pennsylvania, and his career experience includes serving as a police detective.
He has been affiliated with Teamsters Local #205, the McKeesport Area School District and the Safe Schools Committee.
Goughnour assumed office on April 7, 2025, succeeding Matthew Gergely.
